promo.trust.title: Book with total peace of mind
promo.trust.subtitle: PALTAS keeps every booking safe from search to check-in.
promo.trust.payments.title: Secure payments
promo.trust.payments.body: Every payment is processed through trusted, encrypted payment providers — your card details are never stored by us.
promo.trust.noFees.title: No hidden fees, ever
promo.trust.noFees.body: The price you see is the price you pay — cleaning, service and taxes all shown upfront.
promo.trust.checks.title: Checks you can read
promo.trust.checks.body: Where we have verified an identity, a title deed or a licence, the listing says so and says what was checked. Where we have not, it says nothing.
promo.travel.title: Where to next?
promo.travel.subtitle: Discover stays travellers love across the region.
promo.early.title: Book early, stay for less
promo.early.body: The best homes get booked fast. Reserve now with instant confirmation and secure payment — simple, fast, and no hidden fees.
promo.business.title: Building or managing property? Do it all on PALTAS.
promo.business.body: List your rooms, manage tenants and rent, track leads, or sell units in your development — all from one dashboard, with secure payments built in.
promo.slide.hajj.headline: Stay within walking distance of the Haram.
promo.slide.hajj.copy: Apartments and hotels for pilgrims and their families, with group rates, prayer-time quiet hours and hosts who understand the season.
promo.slide.hajj.promise: Your payment is held until you have checked in.
promo.slide.umrah.headline: Shorter trip. Same care taken over where you sleep.
promo.slide.umrah.copy: Book a week or a weekend near the Haram without paying peak Hajj rates. Flexible cancellation, and your money stays in escrow until you have checked in.
promo.slide.umrah.promise: The total you see is the total you pay.
promo.slide.marrakesh.headline: A riad inside the medina, not a hotel outside it.
promo.slide.marrakesh.copy: Courtyard houses with plunge pools and rooftop terraces, a few minutes from Jemaa el-Fnaa. Hosts arrange the airport transfer and the hammam.
promo.slide.marrakesh.promise: Every check we have made is shown, and says what was checked.
promo.slide.miami.headline: Ocean Drive on one side, the Atlantic on the other.
promo.slide.miami.copy: Art-deco apartments and beachfront condos in South Beach and Brickell, with the full price shown before you book — resort fees and all.
promo.slide.miami.promise: No resort fee appears at the payment step.
